The '''Gree Baaker system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gree Baaker]], home to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Gree Baaker Labor Camp|Labor Camp]]. Some of its prisoners ended up on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="RFT" />
